# Security Policy

## Reporting a Vulnerability

To report a security vulnerability, please contact us directly at [security@example.com](mailto:security@example.com). Your report will be treated with the utmost confidentiality.

## Supported Versions

We will support the current version and the previous version of the software. Please ensure you are using a supported version to benefit from security updates.

## Security Updates

We will aim to release security updates for vulnerabilities in a timely manner. Please keep an eye on our GitHub releases and announcements for updates.

## Code of Conduct

We expect all contributors to adhere to our [Code of Conduct](CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md). Any contributions should be made in a respectful and constructive manner.
